title: ADR revisions, week of 2026-11-21: rolling checklist of ADR text out of step with main (one governed PR)
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibvMi1U7R2kBd3JbTPu

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed · Source: maintainer. Ruling-ref: the maintainer, 2026-11-20 ~04:0xZ, verbatim: 「adr接受你的建议」, accepting the rolling weekly card (#35731, now closed by PR #35976): ADR amendment requests that already name a concrete change are collected on one rolling card per week and land as one governed `docs/adr/**` PR. Opened because no card of this name is open (`execution-duties.md`: no open card ⇒ open next week's). ⛔ Not a claim.

## 维护者速读
- 是什么：本周所有「ADR 写的和现在代码不一致」或「ADR 留给某张卡回答、卡已做完」的修订，收在这一张卡里，一次合成一个 PR，你只批一次。
- 为什么：AI 席位改代码前会读 ADR；ADR 与代码矛盾或留着已答的开放问题，会把 AI 带偏。
- 收录规则：只收与主干矛盾或已被落地 PR 回答的；纯补记不收。
- 要你做什么：PR 好了以后批一次（`docs/adr/**` 需你亲手批）。

## How this card works
- One checklist row per ADR passage that disagrees with `main` or an open item a landed PR answers. A seat that finds a new one appends a row here (ADR, section, what it says, what is true now, the landing PR) instead of filing a card.
- Each row lands as an append-only dated note; the original decision text is not rewritten.
- A row whose prerequisite PR has not merged stays unchecked; the PR carries only rows whose code is on `main`.
- The card closes when its PR merges; next week's rows open a new card of this name.

## Rows
- [ ] **ADR-0158 Open item 12, the aggregate half** (from #35491, whose Done-when ends "ADR-0158 is amended with the raw-aggregate set"): says "Which aggregates count as \"raw\" under U7 R1's refusal is the aggregate card's". What is true once PR #36060 merges: `sum`, `avg`, `min` and `max` over a `record`-mode quantity are raw and refused unless grouped by the quantity's own `unitField` (ObjectQL aggregate `INVALID_FIELD` / 400; `summary` registration `INVALID_METADATA` / 422, every such roll-up refused in R1 per L3; analytics cube measure `INVALID_FIELD` / 400); `count` and `count_distinct` are not judged; a `fixed`-mode quantity and a number with no `unitConfig` pass; no new code. The dataset "at build" half is per query, as currency does on main; the compile guard for both families is #36083 (route 7062776103 on #35491). Prerequisite: PR #36060 merged.
- [ ] **ADR-0066 D2 ⑧, ADR-0090 D5 and D12 (a), ADR-0151 D3 — the read-only `viewAllFields` bit** (from #36050, step 2 of the ruled #34365; carrier note 7063894249; L2 record 7063858938). What is true now, after PR #36085 merged as 78437e20d7: `ObjectPermissionSchema` accepts an optional `viewAllFields`. It casts a read vote, never an edit vote, on every field the field merge holds, through the shared `superuserFieldVote` (both `getFieldPermissions` and `buildEffectiveFieldPermissions`); a set's own `readable: false` row beats its own bit; it grants no object access, no record bypass and no admin posture. `admin_full_access` and `organization_admin` carry it on `'*'` (no behaviour change: their View All / Modify All already cast the same vote); the no-bypass org-admin variant drops it. D2 ⑧ gets a step-2 note saying so, and that the v19 end state is #36055 (View All / Modify All stop voting on fields). ADR-0090 D5: the audience-anchor high-privilege list now names `viewAllFields`. ADR-0090 D12 condition (a): the organization boundary refuses `viewAllFields` on `'*'`. ADR-0151 D3: the agent ceiling clears it. Reach accepted by the L2 (Q2 = A): a `'*'` `viewAllFields` also votes on the fields of private-posture objects; changing that would be a maintainer ruling, free until the first release that carries the key. Prerequisite: PR #36085 merged (met).
